items.title: UK P&I Club sets 4.5% general increase for 2027 policy year amid rising claims costs
items.summary: The mutual provider has agreed to a general increase citing inflation in major casualties and injury claims, alongside plans for its upcoming merger with TT Club.

items.title: Allianz hits record $30.7bn brand value to retain top insurance ranking
items.summary: The German insurer has maintained its position at the head of Interbrand's insurance list as Zurich Insurance Group enters the top 100 for the first time.

items.title: Bank of England governor says AI investment is aiding UK economy
items.summary: Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey has noted that artificial intelligence investment is beginning to provide benefits to the UK economy.

items.title: Scottish Widows reports rise in projected median retirement income for women
items.summary: Scottish Widows reports that the projected median retirement income for women has increased to £14,500, though adequacy concerns persist.

items.title: Alternative Income REIT moves closer to delisting as Glenstone increases stake to 89.3%
items.summary: Glenstone REIT has secured acceptances for nearly 89.3% of Alternative Income REIT's ordinary shares under its ongoing 70p per share offer.

items.title: Sweden leads global pet insurance adoption as UK claims hit £1.23bn
items.summary: Insurance data shows Sweden covers nearly three-quarters of its pets, while UK owners navigate rising veterinary costs and record claims.
